description: A chronic inflammatory disorder affecting hair follicles in intertriginous areas and causing recurrent nodules and abscess-like lesions.

appearance.general: Tender deep nodules, abscess-like lesions, draining sinuses, and scarring may occur in the axillae, groin, or other skin folds.

warning_signs: Rapidly spreading redness, severe pain, fever, or extensive infection warrants medical evaluation.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recurrence, scarring, affected sites, smoking, and any drainage or sinus tracts.
Discuss recurrent nodules, drainage, and scarring because these features help distinguish hidradenitis from isolated boils.
